scenarios.name: Open the ribbon context menu

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the Modify group title
the ribbon context menu offers Ribbon Appearance and Show Panels
it offers Customize User Commands and undocks Ribbon
it offers Docking Positions

scenarios.name: Open the ribbon context menu from the active tab

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
panel titles are shown
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab
the ribbon context menu offers Ribbon Appearance and Show Panels
Show Panel Titles is checked
the menu offers Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the 3D Model ribbon remains visible

scenarios.name: Inspect available ribbon docking positions

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab
opens Docking Positions
the submenu offers Top, Left and Right
Top is checked
the user presses Escape
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the context menu remains open
the user presses Escape again
the context menu closes and the 3D Model ribbon remains docked at the top

scenarios.name: Move the ribbon from the top to both sides and back

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked on the left
the ribbon is docked at the top with the 3D Model tab selected
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Left from Docking Positions
the ribbon tabs are arranged vertically along the left edge
the 3D Model command groups are stacked beside the tabs
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
Left is checked
the user chooses Right from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser is visible on the left of the viewport
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
Right is checked
the user chooses Top from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged horizontally above the viewport
the same part remains active
the model browser remains visible to the left of the viewport

scenarios.name: Undock the ribbon and returns it to the top

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Undock Ribbon
the ribbon floats over the workspace in a vertical panel
its tabs and 3D Model group buttons remain visible
the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title
the context menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right
it does not offer Undock Ribbon
the user chooses Dock to Top
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the same part remains active

scenarios.name: Open the Modify command list on the floating ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Modify group button
the Modify button is highlighted blue
an adjacent command list opens with Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, and other Modify commands
the user selects a face in the viewport outside the command list
the command list closes
the face is highlighted with a one-face selection indicator
the user clicks empty workspace outside the part
the face selection clears
the ribbon remains floating

scenarios.name: Switch compact command groups in the left-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify and Work Features buttons visible
no adjacent group panel is open
the user selects the Work Features group button
Work Features is highlighted blue
an adjacent panel lists Plane, Axis, Point, and UCS
the user selects the Modify group button
the Work Features panel closes
Modify is highlighted blue
an adjacent panel lists Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, Draft, and other Modify commands
the user clicks empty workspace outside the part
the Modify panel closes
the ribbon remains docked on the left
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Scroll the floating ribbon group list

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the floating 3D Model ribbon shows Start 2D Sketch above the lower groups
the user scrolls down in the floating ribbon group list
Start 2D Sketch scrolls out of view
Shape Generator, Work Features, Pattern, and Create Freeform are visible
the ribbon remains floating

scenarios.name: Switch tabs with a floating command panel open

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Annotate tab on the floating ribbon
the ribbon displays Geometric Annotation, General Annotation, Notes, Manage, and Tolerance Analysis groups
the user selects the Notes group
an adjacent panel displays Leader Text, General Note, and General Profile Note commands
the user selects the 3D Model tab
the Notes panel closes
the floating ribbon displays its 3D Model groups again
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Switch tabs on a left-docked ribbon during a modeling command

scenario_steps.name: a part containing a solid block is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user starts Shell from Modify
the user selects a face of the block
the Shell properties panel reports one selected face
the model preview shows the shell cutaway
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user opens its expanded-title context menu
the user opens "Docking Positions"
the user selects "Left"
the 3D Model ribbon is docked vertically on the left of the model browser
Modify is represented by a compact panel button
the Shell properties panel and model preview remain visible
the user selects the Tools tab on the left-docked ribbon
the Tools ribbon groups are displayed on the left
the Shell properties panel still reports one selected face
the model preview remains visible
the user cancels Shell from its properties panel
the properties panel and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
the left-docked Tools ribbon remains selected
the user presses Escape
the command prompt returns to Ready
the user opens "Docking Positions" from the Tools tab context menu
the user selects "Top"
the Tools ribbon appears at the top

scenarios.name: Inspect docking positions from a Manage panel title

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Manage ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the Manage panel title
opens Docking Positions
the submenu offers Top, Left and Right
Top is checked
the user presses Escape
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the context menu remains open
the user presses Escape again
the context menu closes and the Manage ribbon remains docked at the top

scenarios.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the left

scenario_steps.name: a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user undocks the ribbon
chooses Dock to Left from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the left
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user chooses Top from the docked ribbon tab menu
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the right

scenario_steps.name: a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user undocks the ribbon
chooses Dock to Right from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser remains on the left of the viewport
the user opens Docking Positions from the active ribbon tab
Right is checked
the user chooses Top
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Dismiss the floating ribbon title menu with Escape

scenario_steps.name: a part is active and the ribbon is floating
the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title
the menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right
the user presses Escape
the menu closes
the ribbon remains floating
the user opens the floating title menu again
chooses Dock to Top
the ribbon returns to the top dock

scenarios.name: Undock from a pinned expanded panel and redock at the top

scenario_steps.name: a part is active with the full 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user chooses Undock Ribbon from its title context menu
the additional command area closes
the ribbon floats vertically over the workspace
the user docks the floating ribbon at the top
the full ribbon returns to the top
the Modify additional command area is closed
the user opens Modify and clicks empty viewport space
the additional command area closes

scenarios.name: Dock left from an expanded Modify title

scenario_steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user chooses Left from Docking Positions on its title
the ribbon is docked on the left
the Modify additional command area closes
the user opens Docking Positions from the left-docked ribbon
Left is checked
the user chooses Top
the ribbon returns to the top with the additional command area closed

scenarios.name: Select the already active dock from an expanded Modify title

scenario_steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user chooses the checked Top position from Docking Positions on its title
the menus and additional command area close
the ribbon remains docked at the top

scenarios.name: Select the already active left dock from an expanded Modify title

scenario_steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the left
the Modify command area is open
the user opens Docking Positions from the expanded title
Left is checked
the user selects Left
the menus and Modify command area close
the ribbon remains docked on the left

scenarios.name: Switch compact groups in the right-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the right
Modify and Work Features are shown as compact group buttons
the user selects Modify
Modify is highlighted
its command panel opens to the left of the ribbon
the user selects Work Features
its command panel replaces the Modify panel
lists Plane, Axis, Point and UCS
the user docks the ribbon at the top
the temporary command panel closes
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Finish a sketch while the ribbon is docked left

scenario_steps.name: an existing sketch is being edited with the ribbon docked at the top
the user docks the Sketch ribbon on the left
the sketch tools appear in a vertical group column
Finish remains visible in the Exit group at the bottom
the user selects Finish
sketch editing ends and the part model view returns
the ribbon remains docked on the left
the 3D Model tab and groups are active
no sketch geometry has changed

scenarios.name: Open an Annotate command panel on the floating ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active and the ribbon is floating with 3D Model selected
the user selects Annotate
the ribbon displays its annotation groups
the user selects Notes
the adjacent panel lists Leader Text, General Note and General Profile Note
the user selects 3D Model
the Notes panel closes
the modeling groups return
the part remains active

scenarios.name: Keep the ribbon docked while switching document types

scenario_steps.name: a part, an assembly and a sheet-metal part are open in the MCAD Software
the part is active with the ribbon docked on the left
the user activates the assembly document
the ribbon remains docked on the left
assembly tabs and commands are displayed
the browser and viewport show the assembly
the user activates the sheet-metal part
the ribbon remains docked on the left
the Sheet Metal tab and its commands are displayed
the browser and viewport show the sheet-metal part
the sheet-metal part is active
